subject: Renewal launch: capacity uplift runway & calendar lock
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal launch: capacity uplift runway & calendar lock

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the productive renewal signal last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short renewal launch thread to align timeline, stakeholders, and the QBR slot so your team can lock calendars. High-level ask: confirm the capacity uplift target (we have a working number below) and a 60–90 minute QBR window in the week of Jun 10–14 so we can present the execution plan.

Proposed near-term plan:
- Confirm uplift target: +35% peak token throughput (applies to the Nexus model set) — action: Orion Ops
- Mutual Action Plan (attached): we’ll complete milestones for legal, procurement, deployment by Jun 28 — action: Redwood + Orion
- QBR (60–90m): review commitments, performance SLOs, and migration playbook — proposed windows below

Suggested QBR windows (please pick one):
1) Tue Jun 11, 10:00–11:30 PT
2) Wed Jun 12, 13:00–14:30 PT
3) Thu Jun 13, 08:30–10:00 PT

Attachments: Orion_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), QBR_agenda_template.pdf

Next steps for your team: confirm the uplift percent and who from Orion will own deployment validation (unit: Ops / Engineering). If those look good I’ll lock a calendar invite and circulate the QBR agenda.

Thanks — look forward to getting this on the calendar.

—
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Cho <michael.cho@orionhealth.com>, Ops Team <ops@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 25 May 2029 12:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal launch: capacity uplift runway & calendar lock

Thanks Markus — this is helpful. Quick answers from our side:

- Uplift target: +30–35% peak throughput is the right range; we should plan for 35% as the worst-case for capacity planning but will aim for 30% as preferred.
- Deployment validation owner: Michael Cho (cc’d) will run the acceptance tests and coordination with our SRE.
- QBR window: Wed Jun 12, 13:00–14:30 PT works best for both engineering and procurement.

Michael, can you confirm you’re ok with the acceptance checklist in the mutual action plan? We’ll also need the estimated maintenance blackout windows (if any) for the week of deployment.

I’ll leave legal/procurement details to procurement but want to get the technical timing locked.

Cheers,
Sarah
VP Engineering, Orion Health
sarah.lin@orionhealth.com

From: Michael Cho <michael.cho@orionhealth.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orionhealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 26 May 2029 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal launch: capacity uplift runway & calendar lock

On Sun, May 26, 2029 at 12:04 PM Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orionhealth.com> wrote:
> Markus — this is helpful. Quick answers from our side: ...

Markus / Sarah — I reviewed the mutual action checklist and the acceptance tests look fine. A couple of notes: 
- We’ll require an additional pre-prod validation window (2 hours) during which we’ll run peak-traffic synthetic tests. Proposed pre-prod window: Tue Jun 18, 22:00–24:00 PT.
- Maintenance blackout: none currently planned, but we ask Redwood to avoid any disruptive changes on Mon Jun 17–Thu Jun 20 due to other internal releases.
- I’ll share a trimmed acceptance checklist PDF by EOD Mon May 27.

If you want me to join the QBR, I’ll attend the Wed Jun 12 slot for the technical readout.

—
Michael Cho
Senior SRE Manager | Orion Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Michael Cho <michael.cho@orionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal launch: capacity uplift runway & calendar lock

Thanks all — I’ll lock the QBR for Wed Jun 12, 13:00–14:30 PT and send a Zoom invite with the QBR_agenda_template.

Action items captured:
- Markus: circulate a final mutual action plan (v1 → v1.1) with updated acceptance checklist (due Mon May 27)
- Ben: create the QBR invite and attach agenda (done by EOD Mon May 27)
- Michael: share trimmed acceptance checklist PDF (due Mon May 27) and confirm pre-prod window (Tue Jun 18, 22:00–24:00 PT)
- Sarah / Procurement: begin redline review; procurement requests will be routed to our Legal/Contracts SPOC (TBD)

We’ll also add a short performance dashboard during the QBR to show baseline metrics and the simulated uplift impact (token throughput, p95 latency, and cost delta). Monica will follow up on the dashboard template and the post-QBR readiness checklist.

Thanks — sending invites now.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced (not embedded): Orion_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, QBR_agenda_template.pdf
